definitions.explanation: A collective term for the central government ministries ({省|しょう}) and agencies ({庁|ちょう}) of Japan. Refers to the bureaucratic organs of the national government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{省庁|しょうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}する→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Each government ministry and agency cooperates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧{省庁|しょうちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: We are coordinating with the relevant ministries and agencies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{省庁|しょうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再編|さいへん}→再編：07656_saihen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二|に}{〇〇一|せんいち}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The reorganization of central government ministries and agencies was carried out in 2001.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {省|しょう} (ministry) and {庁|ちょう} (agency). In the Japanese government, {省|しょう} refers to larger ministries (e.g., {財務省|ざいむしょう}, Ministry of Finance) and {庁|ちょう} to smaller agencies (e.g., ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧, Meteorological Agency). The word {省庁|しょうちょう} is used as a collective term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{省庁|しょうちょう}: central government ministries
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{省庁|しょうちょう}: each ministry and agency
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧{省庁|しょうちょう}: relevant/related ministries
- {省庁|しょうちょう}⟦{再編|さいへん}→再編：07656_saihen⟧: government ministry reorganization
